payload.entry:
Verified req_apply: cycler carry/drop apply service plus nav notice v6 Undo adapter.

Tests: npm test in bob-plugins 8773 pass / 0 fail / 4 skipped; perf 17/17. Focused RV20–RV28 exact bytes via planReqCloseWrites + injected taskSplitPlanCarryReq; carry_pulled refused without pullInPreflight (req_pull_in_unavailable); unavailable taskSplit refuses carry (split_unavailable) and never uses ordinary split; Met writes nothing; compose restores earliest-before→final-after including created inbox.md; dirty-editor/dest-change stale (req_close_stale); partial live carry reports failures and never claims the unapplied row; post-close [x] owner still carries open reqs. Twin-copy parity still only reqClose*/REQ_CLOSE_* names (198c/d stay cycler-only). Notice v6: req-only Undo, mixed Undo closes, legacy payloads unchanged.

Deploy: bob plugins sync --repo $PWD --no-pull -p task-status-cycler then -p bob-navigation-hotkeys from bob-cli_15 dirty 289c7f6. Cycler vault stamp rewritten from abandoned bob-cli_16 dirty 538d421 via clean origin sync first (bytes already matched 4d4c73c). No -F.

Apply-service seam for close_wiring:
- Cycler (not public plugin.api): planReqCloseWrites({ notes, owners, requests, today, date, sha256Hex, planCarryReq, pullInPreflight?, expectedNotes?, expectedOwnerPostimages?, inboxRoute? }) and mixin applyReqCloseWrites (same plus optional live carryReq/taskSplit/persistDrop/cache/context). Mixin is installed; not advertised on cycler.api.
- notes = post-close live snapshot; owners = frozen pre-close forest from reqCloseCollectOwners. Carry bottom-to-top then drops. Met writes nothing.
- Live carry uses nav api.taskSplit.carryReq({ notePath, line (1-based), expectedLine, expectedOwnerPreimage, today? }); never ordinary split. carry_pulled refused until pullInPreflight (req_delivery).
- Success: { ok: true, req_outcomes/outcomes, met, postimages, restores, notes, jump }. restores { path, before, after, created } composed earliest-before→final-after, including created notes.
- Refusal: { ok: false, code, message } with req_close_stale, split_unavailable, req_pull_in_unavailable. Live persist may also { ok: false, failures: [{ key, code, message, path }] }.
- Nav notice v6: model req_outcomes / req_met plus undo.restores and __noticePlugin. Feature-detect api.notice?.version >= 6. 654 restoreGuardedSnapshots refuses if any postimage changed; created files delete on undo. Keep owner Done on card-verdict undo.

Apply-service seam for close_wiring:
- helpers.createReqPullInPreflight({ day, dayPath, index, completed, closing, today? }) -> pullInPreflight({ owners, verdicts, notes }) closure for planReqCloseWrites/applyReqCloseWrites. day = staged post-close day text or null; completed = [{ path, blockId, isRoot }]; closing = { continuationName, closedLine (0-based), continuation: { line (1-based), created } | null } | null. Refuses req_pull_in_no_destination before any write when a pulled carry has no slot/closing/implicit destination.
- helpers.planReqPullInLinks({ owners, outcomes, day, dayPath, index, completed, closing, notes, today?, routePulledTask?, settings? }) -> { ok, dayAfter, links[], notesAfter, postimages, restores[] }. Run on the apply result notes; merge with composeReqCloseRestores([...applyRestores, ...pullInRestores]) (earliest-before to final-after, incl. created inbox.md). Raises created tasks to Next with no freshness stamp; skips already-live links; refuses req_pull_in_no_destination / req_close_stale with nothing staged. routePulledTask is an optional D7 hook ({ task, taskLine, dayText, dayPath, target, destination, today }) -> { target, destination, routed } | { refusal }; without it destinations stay as resolved.
- helpers.resolveReqLanding({ target, owners, plan, routes, settings? }, finalText) -> { ok, landing: { key, kind: carried_task | moved_with_ancestor | requirement, outcome, path, line (1-based), blockId | null } }. Pin-only writes nothing. Refuses req_jump_lost / req_jump_ambiguous before commit; never navigates (close_wiring owns the final jump + receipt).
- Fragments 198e/198f are cycler-only (no nav twin copy); vectors.json fixture unchanged (byte-identical copy); new tests test-task-status-cycler-req-close-pull-in.cjs (14) + test-task-status-cycler-req-close-landing.cjs (12) registered in test:unit.

These files are unchanged by this phase.

Implemented managed Done close wiring across all paths: captures pre-close scope, routes one requirement-first card with ordered apply, resolves jump landings last, and completes the contract docs. `just check` passed in workspace 21. Clean-base timing flakes `event-link-times` and `frees-marks` remain tracked by bob-cli-km and bob-cli-io; neither file was changed by this phase. Deployed and verified bob-navigation-hotkeys 2.107.0 and task-status-cycler 1.58.1 (`bob plugins list` reports both synced); task-status-cycler was synced without force.

LAND TRIAGE (follow-ups): every PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP on the six phases (.1 #1, .2 #1, .3 #1, .5 #2, .6 #1) is one of two already-tracked 25 ms wall-clock flakes under full npm test load: event-link-times -> bob-cli-km, frees-marks -> bob-cli-io. Recorded attributed notes on both. No +1 because the lander did not reproduce them, and no new task beads. No other distinct follow-up was proposed.

LAND VERIFICATION (incomplete; remaining work is epic work, caused by close_wiring c91ebae). Reproduced against the bob-plugins master harness (55bf2ed): (1) applyManagedReqCloseCard passes picker reqs [{key,verdict,reason}] straight to reqCloseResolveVerdicts, which reads request.selector, so every explicit Drop/Carry/Carry+pull-in from the Obsidian card refuses req_close_stale (selectors ['undefined']); only implicit Met works. (2) resolveManagedReqCloseLanding hands an async reader to the synchronous resolveReqLanding (198f), so every requirement Ctrl+J pin returns req_jump_lost. moved_with_ancestor landings also lack exact text and use a 1-based line. (3) expectedNotes and expectedOwnerPostimages are derived from the same live text at apply time, so external owner-block edits made while the card is open (new req, sibling or title or note edit) are accepted. The plan requires req_close_stale. (4) cycleTaskStatusRange calls captureReqCloseOwnersFromText without identities, and that branch loops over tasks as if they were match arrays, so counted-range closes capture 0 owners. (5) Idless owners never reach finalizeClosedTasks (closedTaskIdentity returns null), so an unanchored owner with Pending reqs never opens the card. (6) The required public-path integration matrix and the real-Obsidian close-card e2e are missing: test-task-status-cycler-req-close-integration.cjs has 6 unit-level tests and obsidian-task-reqs-e2e.cjs has no card scenario. (7) Docs: bob-cli docs/task-requirements.md section 5 says Ctrl+Shift+T on a req keeps ordinary split, but nav carries via api.taskSplit. Section 7 does not describe the Obsidian card's receipts, Undo, Esc, or same-day reopen. docs/task-status-cycler.md has no close-card section. Verified OK: SP1-SP51/RV vectors, the twin parity and 101 focused req-close/carry tests pass, both plugins are deployed and synced (nav 2.107.0, cycler 1.58.1), there are no epic-symbol entries, and commits since the epic began (55bf2ed/7f104e52 Pomodoro mention history, 9d0cbfbe Mac card docs, ledger-tools/props/gmail/tick/highlights) neither conflict with nor duplicate this epic.
